page_title: MNT 3-1 BRE | Montpellier v Brest 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' Abdallah Sima (Brest) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball from the set piece and takes a good first touch to unleash a low shot, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a nice save.
90+3' It seemed like Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+2' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Theo Chennahi (Montpellier) for a tough tackle.
90+2' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) makes a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

89' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Kamory Doumbia (Brest), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
86' Here comes a substitution. Wahbi Khazri is given a rest as he is replaced by Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier).
86' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Theo Chennahi (Montpellier) replacing Rabby Nzingoula.
86' Here's the change. Mama Balde leaves the pitch and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
84' 3 - 1 Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
84' Jordan Amavi (Brest) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
81' Brest show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

78' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
77' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) steps up to send the ball in.
77' Mama Balde (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Brest have a corner.
76' Substitution. Hugo Magnetti walks off the pitch and Mahdi Camara (Brest) comes on as a substitute.

75' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the bottom left corner. Benjamin Lecomte is alert and makes a good save to deny him.
73' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Mousa Al-Tamari is replaced by Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Arnaud Nordin as he is replaced by Othmane Maamma (Montpellier).
71' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
70' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.

70' Abdallah Sima (Brest) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. Brest win a corner.
70' The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
69' Mama Balde (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brest have a corner.
69' Birama Toure (Montpellier) gets booked for the first time in this match.
68' A clumsy foul by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle.

67' Mama Balde (Brest) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
65' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Romain Faivre and he is replaced by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).
63' That's the end of the game for Ibrahim Salah, who is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Brest).
62' Substitution. Jonas Martin makes way for Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
62' The yellow card is received by Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier).
60' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) didn't convert the penalty kick.
59' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is going to take the penalty!

59' Jordan Amavi (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul. Montpellier are awarded a penalty kick!
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

55' Romain Faivre (Brest) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
55' Brest are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
53' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
53' Jordan Amavi (Brest) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul.
50' 2 - 1 Goal! Jonas Martin (Brest) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:1.
50' It seemed like Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

48' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
48' Flag up against Mama Balde (Brest). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

47' Birama Toure (Montpellier) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45+2' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+1' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45+1' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Mama Balde (Brest) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brest.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

44' Luc Zogbe (Brest) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.

43' The opposition back off Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Marco Bizot denies him with the save.

41' Brest slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
39' Substitution. Akor Adams leaves the pitch and is replaced by Birama Toure (Montpellier).
38' The Montpellier players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Jeremie Pignard signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
35' Attention! Referee Jeremie Pignard straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
29' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is saved by Marco Bizot.
28' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
28' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
26' Jonas Martin (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' Jordan Amavi (Brest) produces a shot from a mid-range free kick. His effort is directed under the crossbar but is caught by the goalkeeper.

24' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jeremie Pignard blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Brest.
23' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luc Zogbe (Brest) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
19' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
16' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is awarded a yellow card.
15' Wonderful movement by Brest. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
12' 2 - 0 Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) takes the free kick with a powerful low drive that goes inside the right-hand post and ends up behind the goalkeeper. A real jaw dropper!
11' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul after Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) hacks down one of his opponents. Montpellier are awarded the free kick.
9' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

8' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Bizot into the bottom right corner.
5' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
4' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Brest). A penalty is given to Montpellier!
2' Ibrahim Salah (Brest) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jeremie Pignard.
